q: Design a slab base foundation for a column ISLC 400 @ 91.4 Kg placed back-to-back at clear spacing of 300 mm to carry a factored axial load of 2000 kN. Take safe bearing capacity of soil as 180 kN/m2. Assume Fe 410 of steel and M 25 of concrete.
What are the factors affecting lateral stability of a beam?

Design a simply supported beam of span 5 m carrying design load of 25 kN/m. Assume the compression flange of the beam is laterally restrained throughout. [Note: Check for shear lag effect, deflection, web crippling are not required]
Enlist elements of an Industrial Building. Explain use of purlins.
Explain cross section classification used in limit state.
Enumerate design steps for gantry girder.
Explain “Web Crippling” in flexural members.

Design suitable beam-column. If a column in industrial building frame is subjected to the design axial load of 1000 kN along with design moment about z-z axis at top and bottom of 50 kN.m and 60 kN.m respectively (same nature). Height of column is 4.5 m and supported with hinged at top and fixed at bottom.
Explain in detail ‘Pre-Engineered Building (PEB)’.
Differentiate between Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) and Conventional Steel Building (CSB).

Design a welded plate girder for 30 m span to support a uniformly distributed load of 75 kN/m over full span along with two moving loads 150 kN each spaced at 3 m apart. The girder is laterally supported throughout. Use steel grade of Fe 410 both for Flange as well as web. (Note: Design of weld connection for flange plate and web plate is not required).

Design a tie member roof truss consist of double angle section 2ISA 100×65×8 mm connected back-to-back on either side of gusset 10 mm thick using bolted connection subjected to factored load of 300 kN. The grade of steel Fe 410 for member and grade of bolt used is M16 and class 4.6.
Write short note on “Modes of Failures in Compression Member”

Design a brattening system for a column composed of 2 ISLC 300 @ 66.2 Kg/m placed back-to-back at clear spacing of 220 mm. Axial designed load on column is 1000 kN. Effective length of column is 3.5 m.
Explain stress strain curve of the mild steel in detail.

A rafter of steel roof truss consists of 2ISA 65×65×8 mm placed back- to-back on either side of 10 mm thick gusset plate. The member carries ultimate tensile load of 400 kN. Determine number of 16 mm diameter, 4.6 grade ordinary bolts required for the joint. Take Fu as 410 MPa.
Describe use of ‘Lug Angle’ in connection.

Design a suitable longitudinal fillet weld to connect the plates (200 mm × 12 mm) to transmit a pull equal to the full strength. Assume Gusset plate having width of 300 mm and thickness 14 mm. Grade of plates is Fe 410 and welding is to be made in workshop.

What is effective length of the column? Explain it for different end or support conditions.
